up: For CHEMBL3338195 and all its salt forms, return the ChEMBL ID of the molecule and the IC50 activity values (with standard_units) from assays run against the target CHEMBL395.
sql:
WITH base_mol AS (
    SELECT molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary
    WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3338195'
),
all_related AS (
    -- Include the parent itself
    SELECT molregno FROM base_mol
    UNION
    -- Include all children (salts) where the input molecule is the parent
    SELECT mh.molregno
    FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    JOIN base_mol bm ON mh.parent_molregno = bm.molregno
)
SELECT 
    md.chembl_id, 
    a.standard_value, 
    a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN all_related arm ON a.molregno = arm.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL395'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
